Patient 9 baje message karta hai, reply 11 baje jaata hai. Tab tak wo dusre clinic mein book kar chuka hota hai. 🦷

Leak of the Week: slow reply time. Fix: website form → WhatsApp alert → patient ko turant reply + booking link → next din reminder. Sab automatic.

Comment "LEAK" 👇 free checklist bhejenge: 10 jagah jahan aapke business ki leads chhoot jaati hain.
